name: cyber-aware-creations
description: Nine NIST-aligned skills for security leaders, running locally against your own files. Seven own data and persist it: risk-register scores and tracks a cybersecurity risk register with change history and board dashboards; nist-csf assesses your programme against NIST CSF 2.0 as a tracked Organizational Profile with gap analysis, coverage reporting and read-only crosswalks to ISO 27001, CIS Controls and 800-53; metrics-register trends security metrics and KRIs with direction-aware thresholds; exceptions-register runs the lifecycle of accepted risks and control exceptions and exports the evidence artifact an auditor asks for; incident-materiality structures an SEC Item 1.05 and DORA disclosure determination and its clocks, and never emits a verdict; business-context records the organisation's own facts — revenue base, crown jewels, board-voiced tolerance — and the applicability profile that narrows what a consuming skill asks — every register reads it — risk, posture, metrics, exceptions and incident. vendor-register keeps third-party arrangements with a criticality derived by tracing what each one supports back to a business workflow and confirmed by a named person, and emits no vendor score. ciso-board-translation owns the board-facing language they all call, with sourced regulatory receipts. board-pack assembles the quarterly pack as a print-ready document and an editable PowerPoint deck, and owns no data at all.
